judgments.note: Appeal of a DRB preliminary plat approval for an eight-unit PRD of new houses and duplexes: municipal appeal about new housing.
The court calls it 'this de novo appeal', held an evidentiary hearing and itself granted the application.

Filing undated; start is the Sept. 10, 2002 entry order (on_or_before). End is the Aug. 1, 2003 final decision in the consolidated appeals; no later proceedings are shown. This docket's preliminary plat appeal was treated as essentially moot and merged into the final plat appeal, so the decision concludes both.
The decisions describe both the preliminary and final plat approvals as for the eight-unit PRD (four single-family plus two duplexes = 8 units). Lots are not stated (condominium), so lots unknown.
Preliminary plat approval was 'granted'; whether it carried conditions and its date are not stated for this docket.

The Garens brought this docket's appeal and later withdrew; their relationship and representation are not stated. Intervenors Desautels (represented neighbors on Venus Avenue) continued the consolidated appeal, which by then proceeded as the final plat appeal, so they are not listed as appellants of this docket.

The statement of questions, issued under both dockets, turns on evaluative criteria (design quality, neighborhood pattern, undue adverse effect). This docket's own appeal was treated as essentially moot and merged into the final plat appeal.
The leading questions (intent criteria, design review criteria, compatibility with single-family pattern) are evaluative; same caveat about the merged moot docket.
Final decision granting the application under both dockets; nothing pending shown, though this docket was merged as essentially moot rather than separately decided.
The basement-elimination condition changes the buildings' design; it is offered with an alternative (apply for an amendment).
